parameters.query:
/* ====================================================================
   SECTION 1: INPUT MAPPING & INTENT RANKING
   ==================================================================== */
WITH intent_ranks AS (
    SELECT signal_name, rank_score
    FROM (
        VALUES
            ('sales_contact', 1),          -- HIGHEST INTENT
            ('demo_request', 2),            -- MEDIUM INTENT
            ('pricing_interest', 3),        -- LOW INTENT
            ('product_exploration', 4),
            ('resource_interest', 5)
    ) AS t(signal_name, rank_score)
),

incoming_intent AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT rank_score
            FROM intent_ranks
            WHERE signal_name = $3
        ),
        1
    ) AS current_rank
),

/* ====================================================================
   SECTION 2: READ EXISTING STATE BEFORE WRITE
   ==================================================================== */
previous_event AS (
    SELECT
        email,
        last_outreach_at,
        last_intent_rank AS previous_rank,
        last_intent_signal AS previous_signal,
        last_event_at,
        total_touchpoints,
        COALESCE(heat_score, 0) AS heat_score
    FROM event_idempotency
    WHERE email = $1
),

/* ====================================================================
   SECTION 3: ATOMIC UPSERT
   ==================================================================== */
upserted_event AS (
    INSERT INTO event_idempotency (
        email,
        last_intent_rank,
        last_intent_signal,
        heat_score,
        last_outreach_at,
        last_event_at,
        total_touchpoints,
        last_status,
        last_sub_reason,
        updated_at
    )
    VALUES (
        $1,
        (SELECT current_rank FROM incoming_intent),
        $3,
        0,

        CASE
            WHEN NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM previous_event
            )
            THEN NOW()

            WHEN (
                SELECT last_outreach_at
                FROM previous_event
            ) IS NULL
            OR (
                SELECT last_outreach_at
                FROM previous_event
            ) < NOW() - ($2 * INTERVAL '1 day')
            THEN NOW()

            ELSE (
                SELECT last_outreach_at
                FROM previous_event
            )
        END,

        NOW(),
        1,
        'NEW_LEAD',
        'NEW_EMAIL',
        NOW()
    )

    ON CONFLICT (email) DO UPDATE
    SET
        last_outreach_at = CASE
            WHEN event_idempotency.last_outreach_at IS NULL
            OR event_idempotency.last_outreach_at
                < NOW() - ($2 * INTERVAL '1 day')
            THEN NOW()

            ELSE event_idempotency.last_outreach_at
        END,

        updated_at = NOW()

    RETURNING *
)

/* ====================================================================
   SECTION 4: RETURN GATEKEEPER METRICS TO N8N
   ==================================================================== */
SELECT
    $1::text AS email,
    $3::text AS intent_signal,

    /* 1. High-level status */
    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM previous_event
        )
        THEN 'NEW_LEAD'

        WHEN (
            SELECT last_outreach_at
            FROM previous_event
        ) IS NULL
        OR (
            SELECT last_outreach_at
            FROM previous_event
        ) < NOW() - ($2 * INTERVAL '1 day')
        THEN 'COOLDOWN_EXPIRED'

        ELSE 'DUPLICATE_LEAD'
    END AS status,

    /* 2. Binary gatekeeper */
    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM previous_event
        )
        THEN TRUE

        WHEN (
            SELECT last_outreach_at
            FROM previous_event
        ) IS NULL
        OR (
            SELECT last_outreach_at
            FROM previous_event
        ) < NOW() - ($2 * INTERVAL '1 day')
        THEN TRUE

        ELSE FALSE
    END AS is_new_lead,

    /* 3. Sub-reason classification */
    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM previous_event
        )
        THEN 'NEW_EMAIL'

        WHEN (
            SELECT last_outreach_at
            FROM previous_event
        ) IS NULL
        OR (
            SELECT last_outreach_at
            FROM previous_event
        ) < NOW() - ($2 * INTERVAL '1 day')
        THEN 'REENGAGED'

        WHEN (
            SELECT current_rank
            FROM incoming_intent
        ) < (
            SELECT previous_rank
            FROM previous_event
        )
        THEN 'INTENT_UPGRADE'

        ELSE 'REPEATED'
    END AS sub_reason,

    /* 4. Required state variables for downstream Code Node */
    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT previous_rank
            FROM previous_event
        ),
        (
            SELECT current_rank
            FROM incoming_intent
        )
    ) AS last_intent_rank,

    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT previous_signal
            FROM previous_event
        ),
        $3::text
    ) AS last_intent_signal,

    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT heat_score
            FROM previous_event
        ),
        0
    ) AS heat_score,

    (
        SELECT last_event_at
        FROM previous_event
    ) AS last_event_at,

    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT total_touchpoints
            FROM previous_event
        ),
        0
    ) AS total_touchpoints,

    /* 5. Computed velocity output */
    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM previous_event
        )
        THEN 0

        WHEN (
            SELECT last_event_at
            FROM previous_event
        ) IS NULL
        THEN 0

        ELSE ROUND(
            EXTRACT(
                EPOCH FROM (
                    NOW() - (
                        SELECT last_event_at
                        FROM previous_event
                    )
                )
            )
        )
    END AS delta_t_seconds;

parameters.query:
UPDATE event_idempotency
SET 
    total_touchpoints = $2,
    last_event_at = NOW(),
    last_intent_signal = $3,
    last_intent_rank = $4,
    heat_score = $5,
    last_status = $6,
    last_sub_reason = $7,
    updated_at = NOW()
WHERE email = $1
RETURNING 
    $1 AS email,
    $3 AS intent_signal,
    $4 AS current_rank,
    $5 AS new_heat_score,
    $6 AS heat_tag,
    $7 AS action,
    true AS is_surge,
    $2 AS updated_touchpoints;
